sentences.en: Direct flights between New York and Tokyo commenced recently.
sentences.zh: 最近，纽约和东京之间的直飞航班开始运营。

sentences.en: The surgeon scrubbed thoroughly up to his elbows before commencing surgery.
sentences.zh: 外科医生彻底洗手至肘部后才开始手术。

sentences.en: The conference will commence in due course.
sentences.zh: 会议将在适当的时候开始。
